title: Speaking and reading aloud flash cards

cards.front: Translate: où ?
back: Where?

cards.front: Translate: quand ?
back: When?

cards.front: Translate: pourquoi ?
back: Why?

cards.front: Translate: combien ?
back: How much / how many?

cards.front: Translate: au premier plan.
back: In the foreground.

cards.front: Translate: à l'arrière-plan.
back: In the background.

cards.front: How many photos are on the photo card?
back: Two.

cards.front: Is reading the text aloud allowed in supervised preparation?
back: No.

cards.front: Translate: ils ont l'air contents.
back: They look happy.

cards.front: Translate: je voudrais.
back: I would like.

cards.front: Ask in French where the station is.
back: Où est la gare ?

cards.front: Ask in French how much a ticket costs.
back: Combien coûte le billet ?

cards.front: Ask in French when the train leaves.
back: À quelle heure part le train ?

cards.front: Request a room for two people in French.
back: Je voudrais une chambre pour deux personnes.

cards.front: Say in French that you prefer the train because it is comfortable.
back: Je préfère le train parce que c'est confortable.

cards.front: Say in French that yesterday you visited a museum.
back: Hier, j'ai visité un musée.

cards.front: Say in French that tomorrow you are going to play tennis.
back: Demain, je vais jouer au tennis.

cards.front: Ask politely in French for repetition.
back: Vous pouvez répéter, s'il vous plaît ?

cards.front: For a written scene prompt showing people playing in a park, give one accurate photo-description sentence.
back: Sur la photo, les personnes jouent dans un parc.
Describe the supplied action and setting without inventing identities.

cards.front: Explain why ils ont l'air contents is safer than stating the people's exact feelings as facts.
back: It means they **look** happy, so it presents an inference from their appearance rather than claiming certain knowledge of their feelings.

cards.front: Why does a reply to pourquoi need more than j'aime le sport?
back: Pourquoi asks **why**. Add a reason, such as parce que c'est amusant.

cards.front: Give two sound checks before reading aloud.
back: Check u/ou and nasal vowels; check silent endings and possible liaison.

cards.front: Answer in French: Qu'est-ce que tu as fait le week-end dernier ? Include an activity and a reaction with a reason.
back: Le week-end dernier, j'ai joué au tennis avec mon ami. C'était amusant parce que nous avons gagné notre match.
The completed activity answers the past question; the reaction is developed with a reason.

cards.front: Answer in French: Qu'est-ce que tu vas faire pendant les vacances ? Include a plan and a reason.
back: Je vais visiter ma grand-mère pendant les vacances parce que j'aime passer du temps avec elle. Nous allons préparer un repas ensemble.
Vais visiter fits the future; the reason and shared activity develop the answer.

cards.front: Explain three useful actions in the 15-minute preparation.
back: Read each role-play instruction and prepare the exact information or question.
Read the aloud text silently and identify sound groups/phrasing.
Prepare relevant visible details for both photos.

cards.front: For two written scene prompts—people playing in a park; people eating inside—give one statement about each and a supported contrast.
back: Sur la première photo, les personnes jouent dans un parc. Sur la deuxième photo, les personnes mangent à l'intérieur. La première scène est dehors, tandis que la deuxième est dedans.
Both scenes are addressed; the contrast follows the supplied locations.

cards.front: Answer in French: Que penses-tu de ton quartier ? Give a view, a reason, a local detail and a drawback.
back: J'aime mon quartier parce qu'il est calme. Il y a un parc où je retrouve mes amis. Cependant, il n'y a pas assez de bus.
The opinion answers directly; a reason, an example and a contrast add relevant detail.

cards.front: Correct four problems in this speaking plan: describe one photo only; read the text aloud in preparation; answer an 'ask a price' prompt with a price; memorise only one theme.
back: Describe **both** photos.
Read silently in supervised preparation.
Ask **Combien coûte... ?** when instructed to ask a price.
Prepare to communicate across all three themes.
